ann.t: Change in Management — Veegaland Developers Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management - Appointment of Secretarial Auditor
Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP — Veegaland Developers Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Cessation — Veegaland Developers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of  Mr. Kurian Thomas as Executive Director of the company w.e.f. November 09, 2026.

Press Release — Veegaland Developers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 05, 2026, titled "Press Release - Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Veegaland Developers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Press Release — Veegaland Developers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 06, 2026, titled "Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Veegaland Developers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended June 30, 2026.
